Prevention: If direct seeding: sowing rate of 15-20 kg/rai
Plant early harvest rice varieties e.g.
Pre-planting: plough soil and stubble, flooding the filed for 1 month to damage pupae
Nitrogen (46-0-0) not over 10 kg/rai. (16-20-0) not over 30 kg/rai
Baryard grass ( Echinochloa crus- galli ), an alternative host.
Monitoring: At 3-4 weeks look for the stem symptoms (dead heart).
If more than 10-15% (ETLs) use direct control.
Make homemade light traps and place around field to monitor for adults
Restrictions: Spray at larva stage if dead hearts present on more than 10-15% of the crop.
Don’t apply granular insecticide, don’t mix insecticides, don’t use 36 chemicals in the
RD list (will kill natural enemy and cause resistance)
